## Art sitting 2, again: the Main Gate and the Mountain Path's veil

3 rows, each painted twice: the Main Gate as a great gatehouse; the Mountain Path, version A and version B, each with the veil painted again.

Run this in the **local ComfyUI**. Press **Run** once.

Each row is one picture, painted twice: **version A** on top, **version B** under it. You choose between them afterwards.

The **Load Image** boxes on the left should already show their pictures. If one shows an error, click **choose file to upload** and pick the file with the same name from `JJK Game images/ui2/early`.

**Cost:** 6 pictures, about **$0.96** (Nano Banana Pro, about $0.16 a picture, charged to your Comfy account).

You don't need to save anything: the results go to ComfyUI's output folder and Claude picks them up from there.

If it stops with a rate-limit or "high demand" error, wait a minute and press **Run** again: a finished picture is reused, not paid for twice (as long as ComfyUI hasn't been restarted).

widgets_values: This is a background picture for a visual novel: a new picture of one part of a traditional Japanese mountain school, with timber halls, grey tiled roofs, cedar forest and green mountains behind. Picture 1 is the central courtyard, already painted: the new picture shows the same school, and every building the two pictures share must look the same in both. THE PLACE: the main gate of the school, seen from the footpath at the foot of the steps, looking north and uphill. The ground: a flagstone footpath between tall cedars and stone lanterns, with no road; a tall stone torii at the foot of a long, wide flight of stone steps; at the top of the steps the school's main gate, a great two-storey timber gatehouse with a heavy grey tiled roof, its tall doors standing open, set in a long stone wall. The gatehouse is the largest thing in the picture and stands in the middle, at the top of the steps; the school's buildings stand behind the wall, higher up. Through the open gate is the open flagstone court of the central courtyard's picture: no hall stands there. The pagoda of the central courtyard's picture may show above the wall, on the left; no tower and no pagoda stands in the middle or on the right. On the left: the schoolhouse, a two-storey schoolhouse of warm brown timber boarding, two rows of large white-framed windows, the same building that stands on the left of picture 1; the schoolhouse's roof and upper windows show above the wall, on the left. Straight ahead: the central courtyard, a wide flagstone court; it is reached up the steps and through the open gate. On the right: the training hall, a broad brown-timber hall with a deep roofed veranda and paper-screened sliding doors, the same building that stands on the right of picture 1; the training hall's roof shows above the wall, on the right. The picture is seen from a standing person's eye height, the horizon a little above the middle. Level open ground runs across the whole bottom of the picture, with nothing tall standing on it. Leave the right ninth of the picture and the top-left corner free of doors, steps, signs and machines: put nothing there that a visitor would walk to or use. Every door, flight of steps and path named above is clearly visible, and no two of them are close together. THE LOOK: a real place you could walk into, drawn as a clean modern anime background. Believable materials (wood grain, glass with soft reflections, stone, plaster, fabric), physically believable light with soft shadows and bounced light, real depth. Clean and well kept: walls are fresh and even, with no stains, cracks, peeling, damp patches or dirt, and there is no dust, litter or fallen leaves on the floor or the ground; everything that belongs to the place is still there. Crisp precise edges, clean clear colour, no film grain, no noise, no canvas texture, no visible brush strokes, no haze or glow washing out detail. Through every window a clear, in-focus view. No people, no animals, no text, no logos. Output a 16:9 picture.

widgets_values: This is a background picture for a visual novel. Picture 1 is the picture to change; picture 2 only shows what one thing looks like. Change one thing in picture 1 and keep everything else exactly as it is. On top of the hill, at the head of the stone stairs, picture 1 has a flat grey wall: take it away. In its place paint one enormous dome standing over the top of that hill: a perfectly smooth half-sphere, like polished black glass, opaque and nearly black, with a faint dark-violet sheen and one small soft highlight near its top. It is far larger than any building: its base is hidden behind the crest of the hill and the trees, and its curve rises high into the sky, clean and sharp against the blue. Picture 2 shows such a dome over a forest: copy the dome's shape, darkness and finish from it, and nothing else. The dome is solid and still: no streaks, no smoke, no mist, no rays, no lightning and no glow around it. Keep the camera, the stairs, every tree and rock, the standing stone and the low gate, the house with its steam, the paths, the river, the colours and the light of picture 1 exactly as they are, and add nothing else. No people, no animals, no text. Output a 16:9 picture.
